title: schc_session_table.h: document new -ENOBUFS return for tombstone_put/floor_put
description: mzt7 codereview finding (3x passes converged): the fail-closed NULL-slot guards in schc_session_table.c add a -ENOBUFS return to lichen_schc_tombstone_put and lichen_schc_floor_put, but schc_session_table.h:175 and :203 @return docs still list only 0 and -EINVAL, and tombstone_put prose (:168) says recording never fails for capacity. Update both @return lines (and soften the never-fails prose) so the public contract matches. Doc-only change; in-tree callers (void)-cast or test ==0 so no runtime impact.
